# Merging all indicators into the TR current status score

This script brings in all current status scores for the components of TR, and puts them together. 

TR = avg(Quantity + Quality + Sustainability)

Quantity = tourist arrivals (avg int + dom)

Quality = avg(crime/coastal pop + activities)
activities = avg(2/5 * food&drink emp / tourist arrivals + 2/5 * cultural&gulf-related / tourist arrivals + 1/5 * other_recreational / tourist arrivals)

Sustainability = avg(hotel sustainability certifications [distintivo s, green key, green globe] + blue flag + CONANP investment + job quality)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(here)
```


```{r}
## for plotting:
rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region_1" = "#C03729",
  "Region_2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region_3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region_4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region_5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region_6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region_7" = "#747428",
  "Region_8" = "#627391",
  "Region_9" = "#8d61a9"
)

region_levels <- paste0("Region_", 1:9)
```


## Quantity

```{r}
# read in quantity
cs_quantity <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/output_quantity","tr_quantity_current_status_121025.csv")) %>% 
  rename(final_score = score) %>% 
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, year, final_score)

# ensure regions are factors
cs_quantity_clean <- cs_quantity %>%
  mutate(rgn_id = factor(rgn_id, levels = region_levels))
```

```{r}
library(plotly)

quantity_plotly <- plotly::plot_ly(
  cs_quantity, 
  x = ~year, 
  y = ~final_score, 
  color = ~rgn_id, 
  colors = rgn_colors,
  type = "scatter", 
  mode = "lines+markers"
) %>% 
  layout(
    title = "CURRENT STATUS: Tourism & Recreation Quantity",
    xaxis = list(title = "Año // Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Puntaje // Percent (out of 100)")
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    x = range(cs_quantity$year), 
    y = c(100, 100),
    line = list(color = "black", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Meta // Goal 2030 (100/100)",
    inherit = FALSE
  )
quantity_plotly
```

### Merge

```{r}
merge_quality <- bind_rows(cs_quality_activities, cs_quality_crime) %>% 
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, year, score, quality_type) %>% 
  filter(year %in% 2019:2024) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = quality_type,
    values_from = score
  ) 

cs_quality <- merge_quality %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    final_score = mean(c(activities, crime), na.rm = TRUE),
    final_score = ifelse(is.na(final_score), NA, final_score) # for rgn_2 2019:2020
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 

cs_quality_clean <- cs_quality %>% 
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, year, final_score)

write_csv(cs_quality_clean, here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/output_quality","cs_quality_all_indicators_032326.csv"))
```

```{r}
library(plotly)

quality_plotly <- plotly::plot_ly(
  cs_quality, 
  x = ~year, 
  y = ~final_score, 
  color = ~rgn_id, 
  colors = rgn_colors,
  type = "scatter", 
  mode = "lines+markers"
) %>% 
  layout(
    title = "CURRENT STATUS: Tourism & Recreation Quality",
    xaxis = list(title = "Año // Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Puntaje // Percent (out of 100)")
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    x = range(cs_quality$year), 
    y = c(100, 100),
    line = list(color = "black", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Meta // Goal 2030 (100/100)",
    inherit = FALSE
  )
quality_plotly
```



## Sustainability

### Sustainability certifications

#### Hotel sustainability certifications (Dist. S, Green Key & Green Globe)

Using 100+ employees as the cutoff for a "large hotel". The percent of large hotels with all kinds of certifications are in `sust_cert_current_status_final_2019_2024_100over_070126.csv`, which I built in `tr_sustainability_total_update.qmd`.

```{r}
cs_sust_cert <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/output_sustainability","sust_cert_current_status_final_2019_2024_100over_070126.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(sust_type = "sust_cert") %>% 
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, year = cert_year, score = current_status, sust_type) %>% 
  filter(year %in% 2019:2024) %>% # to match other indicators
  mutate(rgn_id = factor(rgn_id, levels = region_levels))

sust_cert_plotly <- plotly::plot_ly(
  cs_sust_cert, 
  x = ~year, 
  y = ~score, 
  color = ~rgn_id, 
  colors = rgn_colors,
  type = "scatter", 
  mode = "lines+markers"
) %>% 
  layout(
    title = "TR Sustainability: certified large hotels (Dist. S, Green Key & Green Globe) / total large hotels",
    xaxis = list(title = "Año // Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Puntaje // Percent (out of 100)")
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    x = range(cs_sust_cert$year), 
    y = c(100, 100),
    line = list(color = "black", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Meta // Goal (100/100)",
    inherit = FALSE
  )
sust_cert_plotly
```

### Job Quality

Raw CS scores:
```{r}
cs_sust_job_quality <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/output_sustainability","tr_job_quality_sustainability_current_status_merged_033026.csv")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, year = ano_censal, score = tr_job_quality_cs_raw) %>% 
  mutate(sust_type = "job_quality") %>% 
  filter(year %in% 2019:2025) # because everything else goes/will go through these years.... only one year of scores within these years (census every 5 years).
```

### Merge

```{r}
merge_sust <- bind_rows(merge_sust_certifications, cs_sust_investment_tourism_management, cs_sust_job_quality) %>% 
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, year, score, sust_type) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sust_type,
    values_from = score
  ) 

cs_sust <- merge_sust %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    final_score = mean(c(sust_certifications, conanp_fee_budget, job_quality), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 

cs_sust_clean <- cs_sust %>% 
  dplyr::select(rgn_id, year, final_score) %>% 
  filter(year %in% 2019:2024)

write_csv(cs_sust_clean, here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/output_sustainability","cs_sust_all_indicators_070126.csv"))
```

```{r}

cs_sust_clean <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/output_sustainability","cs_sust_all_indicators_070126.csv"))

sust_plotly <- plotly::plot_ly(
  cs_sust_clean, 
  x = ~year, 
  y = ~final_score, 
  color = ~rgn_id,
  colors = rgn_colors,
  type = "scatter", 
  mode = "lines+markers"
) %>% 
  layout(
    title = "Overall TR Sustainability",
    xaxis = list(title = "Año // Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Puntaje // Percent (out of 100)")
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    x = range(cs_sust_clean$year), 
    y = c(100, 100),
    line = list(color = "black", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Meta // Goal 2030 (100/100)",
    inherit = FALSE
  )
sust_plotly
```



# TR Score

```{r}
all_cs_indicators <- bind_rows(cs_sust_clean, cs_quality_clean, cs_quantity_clean) %>% 
  group_by(rgn_id, year) %>% 
  summarize(tr_current_status = mean(final_score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  filter(year %in% 2019:2024) %>% 
  ungroup()

write_csv(all_cs_indicators, here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/output","tr_current_status_final_070126.csv"))

tr_goc_score <- all_cs_indicators %>% 
  filter(year == 2024) %>% 
  summarize(tr_goc_2024 = mean(tr_current_status)) # overall for this year (03/23/26): 70.48207!!!
```

```{r}
library(plotly)

tr_score_plotly <- plotly::plot_ly(
  all_cs_indicators, 
  x = ~year, 
  y = ~tr_current_status, 
  color = ~rgn_id, 
  colors = rgn_colors,
  type = "scatter", 
  mode = "lines+markers"
) %>% 
  layout(
    title = "CURRENT STATUS: Tourism & Recreation",
    xaxis = list(title = "Año // Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Puntaje // Percent (out of 100)")
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    x = range(all_cs_indicators$year), 
    y = c(100, 100),
    line = list(color = "black", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Meta // Goal 2030 (100/100)",
    inherit = FALSE
  )
tr_score_plotly
```

```{r}
mapview(all_cs_indicators_2024_ohigns, 
        zcol = "tr_current_status",
        col.regions = colorRampPalette(c('#FEE090', '#ABD9E9', '#4575B4', '#313695')),
```

```{r}
  # Theme
  theme(

    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position  = "right",

    legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),

  )
```
